Article Title: 12 hours of mayhem in Manipur: 9 killed as violence engulfs Manipur’s hill districts
Article Text:
Since the outbreak of the Naga-Kuki clashes in February, at least 22 Nagas and 31 Kukis have been killed.





GUWAHATI: Nine people, including a Kuki mother of five and a Gorkha farmer, were killed in 12 hours of violence across three Manipur districts, as houses and shops were torched and gunfights erupted, prompting prohibitory orders in Kamjong and an indefinite shutdown call on NH-202.Since the outbreak of the Naga-Kuki clashes in February, at least 22 Nagas and 31 Kukis have been killed.The toll, comprising six Nagas, two Kukis and a Gorkha farmer, makes it one of the deadliest outbreaks in the state in the past year. While state authorities did not identify those behind the attacks, Naga and Kuki civil society groups accused militant outfits operating in Manipur and across the Myanmar border of orchestrating the killings.The violence on Saturday followed the death of Domkhonei Touthang, a 42-year-old Kuki woman, at Chassad village in Kamjong on Friday night. She was among those protesting the dismantling of village guard posts by joint teams of the police, the Indian Reserve Battalion and the Border Security Force Police sources said she was caught in crossfire between security forces and militants. Hit by two bullets — one in the leg and another in the chest — she died around 10pm.Kuki-Zo groups held the security forces and the NSCN (IM) responsible for her death.Tension escalated rapidly. By early Saturday, unidentified groups from the Kuki and Naga communities were setting fire to houses and shops in each other’s areas amid intense gunfights.At Chassad, 22-year-old Michael Ngamminlen Haokip was killed in an attack that began around 4.30am. Several Kuki houses were burnt, with the Kuki CSO Working Committee alleging that the NSCN (IM) was behind the attack.Around 9.30am, two Naga civilians from Ningchou village, near the India-Myanmar border, were killed by suspected Kuki militants. They were identified as Ngachanso Ningshen, 35, and Leishishan Leishadang, 45.At around the same time in Kangpokpi district, armed men allegedly belonging to Kuki SoO groups surrounded Makui Asang, a Liangmai Naga village, and opened heavy fire. Naga village defenders, armed with licensed firearms and single-barrel guns, retaliated. Four defenders were killed, including Ajinpou Ringkangmai, who was beheaded. The others were identified as Daimai Machungammamg, Robert and D Ringkangmai.In a separate incident, Sandeep Rai, a 40-year-old Gorkha farmer, was shot dead by unidentified gunmen around 6am on Saturday while driving along the Mahadev-Toloi-Pfutsero road in Ukhrul district.Between August 27 and September 26, at least 21 people were killed in Naga-Kuki violence in Manipur, including 11 Nagas and 10 Kukis. The toll also included an unborn child, taking the total number of deaths to 22. The highest toll in a single incident was reported in Kangpokpi on Aug 27, when four Nagas were killed. Another four Nagas were killed in Kamjong on Sept 24. The killings were reported in Kangpokpi, Tamenglong, Noney, Jiribam, Kamjong and Senapati.Manipur chief minister Y Khemchand Singh was in New Delhi, where he met Prime Minister Narendra Modi . The CM wrote on X that Modi had assured the state government of all possible help in its efforts to restore peace and normalcy.The CM’s office said, “The prime minister acknowledged the state government’s efforts to restore peace and normalcy in Manipur. He felt that the situation in the state has improved….”Former chief minister N Biren Singh also took to X to express alarm over the deteriorating security situation.“Particularly disturbing is the killing of Sandeep Rai, a member of the Nepalese community,” he said.“What is going on? How weak have we become that armed militants can kill people, burn down police stations and challenge the authority of the Indian state with such impunity?,” he wrote.He added, “This is a serious threat to our country’s internal security and sovereignty. All illegally held weapons must be recovered, launch decisive operations against armed militant groups and strengthen our Indo-Myanmar border. Both state and central security forces must act without further delay.”
Article Summary: Nine people, including a Kuki mother of five and a Gorkha farmer, were killed in 12 hours of violence across three Manipur districts. The toll makes it one of the deadliest outbreaks in the state in the past year. Since the outbreak of the Naga-Kuki clashes in February, at least 22 Nagas and 31 Kukis have been killed.

Article Title: 'Maintain peace for 1 year': CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka released from detention
Article Text:
Delhi Police said the three leaders were preventively arrested under Sections 126 and 170 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) on October 10.





NEW DELHI: An executive magistrate court on Sunday released Cockroach Janta Party ( CJP ) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from detention, a day after Delhi Police detained them following their arrival in the national capital ahead of a planned protest at Jantar Mantar.They were released on condition that they would not "breach peace" for a year, CJP legal affairs head Ratna Singh said.Advocate Soutik Banerjee also confirmed their release, saying, “All three (Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das) have been released. They can go from here.”Delhi Police said the three leaders were preventively arrested under Sections 126 and 170 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) on October 10. They were produced before the Sub-Divisional Executive Magistrate (SEM) court in Delhi Cantonment on Sunday, police said.“All due legal procedures were followed,” Delhi Police said, adding that a surety bond of Rs 50,000 was furnished to ensure peace and good behaviour for one year, following which the court released them.In a post on X after their release, CJP said, “Finally Delhi Police is forced to release Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das.”“Cockroaches never die,” the party added.The three leaders were detained by Delhi Police immediately after their flight landed in the national capital on Saturday and were subsequently placed under preventive arrest ahead of the planned protest at Jantar Mantar, police said.The detentions came amid a major security clampdown in Delhi. More than 7,000 protesters were detained at multiple locations, preventing them from reaching Jantar Mantar, police sources said.Several opposition leaders, including former chief ministers Arvind Kejriwal, Mamata Banerjee, Pinarayi Vijayan and Manik Sarkar, were also detained while attempting to join the protest.The CJP renewed its call for a protest at Jantar Mantar on Sunday as police continued security arrangements across the city. More than 30,000 police and paramilitary personnel were to be deployed, according to the report.The CJP and opposition parties have been demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter rolls.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party ( CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka released. They were released on condition that they would not "breach peace" for a year. The three leaders were detained by Delhi Police immediately after their flight landed in the national capital on Saturday.

Article Title: Trump throws another tantrum about not getting Nobel, declares war on Norway
Article Text:
Trump denounced Oslo for an “indelible stain” on its reputation

TOI correspondent from Washington:

Donald Trump has ended eight wars, or so he says, but he cannot make peace with the Norwegian Nobel committee. The US President threw an almighty tantrum on Friday night after failing to win the Nobel Peace Prize he has long coveted, declaring it “forever discredited,” and denouncing Oslo for an “indelible stain” on its reputation -- because it did not award him.He also dismissed this year’s winner, Navi Pillay, as a woman “nobody has ever heard of” and “I don’t know what the woman has done,” even as his administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying the move was aimed at ending the threat the “rogue court” posed to U.S. sovereignty. Pillay, a South African of Indian origin, has long been part of the international justice system.“I settled 8 WARS, am close to ending or settling 2 more… Yet, with all of that I, or the United States of America, did not get the Noble Peace Prize. WOW!” Trump posted on his “Truth Social” platform, misspelling the award, which is named after Alfred Nobel, not the adjective. This came after a ten-minute tirade at a rally in Syracuse, were he said rejecting him for the award reflects poorly on Norway and “those people that made such an disgraceful and embarrassing decision.“We will not forget,” he warned NorwayIt was a monumental meltdown from a president who has spent years making sure everyone hears about how much he deserves the prize. But his tirades are now becoming the butt of jokes, with comparisons being made to a child overturning the dinner table because somebody else got the birthday cake. “Trump is beginning to resemble a jilted suitor who insists he never wanted the relationship in the first place, while checking the other person's social media every five minutes,” one wag quipped.The MAGA boss has been cultivating his Nobel grievance with the dedication of a schoolboy campaigning for head prefect, repeatedly claiming credit for ending eight wars -- including a four-day skirmish between India and Pakistan -- complaining that his supposed diplomatic achievements have gone unrecognised. Last year, he was reported to have phoned Norwegian finance minister Jens Stoltenberg to press his case, illustrating the extraordinary spectacle of an American president lobbying for a personal honour that is meant to recognise contributions to peace, not the persistence of its most enthusiastic applicant.He has also cited endorsements from foreign leaders, including Pakistan’s Shahbaz Sharif, for his claim. Just hours before the Nobel Committee announced the award, Sharief again fed into the fetish, posting on X: President Donald Trump played a historic role in advancing peace in South Asia. His timely intervention helped bring Pakistan and India back from the brink and secure a ceasefire, that is holding till today. In recognition of his outstanding contribution, Pakistan had nominated President Trump for the Nobel Peace Prize. We sincerely hope President’s efforts to promote peace and prevent conflict in our region receive due recognition this time.Pakistan had already announced it nominated him for the 2025 Award. Sharif’s last-minute reminder was therefore less a fresh discovery of Trump's peacemaking genius than another attempt to suck up to the MAGA boss. The Nobel committee proved impervious to the diplomatic equivalent of sending flowers before the results.Trump's disappointment is not new. Last year, Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado gave him her Nobel medal, a gesture that apparently did not satisfy his desire for the real thing. FIFA subsequently created a peace prize of its own for him (dubbed the “Appease Prize” by comedians), but even the consolation trophy failed to close the gap between what he has received and what he believes he is owed.This year’s snub has also revived his antipathy towards South Africa, whose government he has repeatedly attacked over its domestic policies and its legal action against Israel at the International Court of Justice. Pillay, an 85-year-old jurist who fought apartheid and served as UN high commissioner for human rights, was an especially unwelcome choice for a president hostile to the international institutions with which she has been associated.Pillay, five years older than the 80-year old US Prez, was not entirely without a sense of humor about Trump the tyke. After receiving the prize, she joked that she might share it with him if the applause was sufficiently enthusiastic. It was a generous offer, though one suspects Trump would prefer the original -- in gold -- with his name engraved on it.
Article Summary: US President threw an almighty tantrum on Friday night after failing to win the Nobel Peace Prize. Trump denounced Oslo for an “indelible stain” on its reputation. He dismissed this year’s winner, Navi Pillay, as a woman “nobody has ever heard of”

Article Title: Nepal floods: 10 missing as Budhi Gandaki River washes away 6 bridges in Gorkha
Article Text:
The flood struck the northern part of the Gorkha district around 4 am.

Six bridges swept away, houses damaged

Nepal Army deploys teams for rescue

At least 10 people have been reported missing after flooding along the Budhi Gandaki River basin in Nepal’s Gorkha district early Sunday. The floodwaters swept away six bridges, damaged several settlements and forced residents to flee to safer areas.The flood struck the northern part of the district around 4 am, officials said. Authorities are monitoring the river as its water level continues to fluctuate, while security personnel have been mobilised for search, rescue and evacuation operations.Assistant chief district officer Netra Prasad Sharma told ANI that 10 people had been reported missing since the flooding began.“In addition, 10 people have been reported missing since the flood hit the northern part of the district earlier this morning. An alert is in place as the river’s water level has continued to rise and fall. We are constantly monitoring the flow,” Sharma added.The flood swept away six bridges, including two motorable bridges and four suspension bridges, according to officials. Bridges at Arughat, Tripurasundari and Soti-Manbu were among those reported damaged or destroyed, Sharma said.A Bailey bridge connecting wards 1 and 3 of Dharche Rural Municipality was also swept away.Other affected crossings included footbridges linking Machhikhola with Karauja, Thadobharyang with Jagat, and Ghattekhola with Philim.Nearly 35 houses in Painyu and Bagar in Ward 3 of Chumnubri Rural Municipality were swept away. Settlements in Jagat, Salleri, Dovan and Ghattekhola were also damaged.Also read: Nepal cuts 12 year wait, to declare those missing in flood 'dead' after 45 days Chumnubri Rural municipality deputy chair Laxmi Gurung said the flooding had caused extensive damage to the local market.“The Budhigandaki flood is reminiscent of the Bhotekoshi flood,” she said, according to Online Khabar. “It has washed away dozens of houses. It is not possible to say the exact extent of the damage right now.”Residents of riverside settlements, including Chumling and Lokpa, fled their homes after hearing loud roaring sounds from nearby streams around 4 am. Tourists staying at local hotels also left for safer areas, residents said, PTI reported.Prime Minister Balen Shah said a Nepal Army contingent had been deployed by air and land to conduct search and rescue operations.Helicopters were also mobilised to support relief and evacuation efforts, while a joint rapid response team from Kathmandu was airlifted to the affected area.The Nepal Army later said six people had been evacuated to safer locations. The affected region is around 184 km from Kathmandu.Home minister Sudan Gurung said security personnel, including helicopter teams, had been deployed to assist with rescue and relief operations. He also warned that the river’s flow was continuing to rise and that muddy floodwaters had entered some houses in Ghattekhola.In a social media post, Gurung expressed concern over the destruction of the bridge connecting Nyakchet and Film Bazaar in Ward 3 of Chumnubri Rural Municipality.He urged residents of Sirdibas, Jagat, Salleri, Khorlabesi, Machhakhola, Soti, Arkhet and Arughat, particularly those living along the Budhi Gandaki riverbanks, to move to safer areas immediately.He also asked the people requiring emergency assistance to contact the ministry of home affairs on 1234. Authorities were also using loudspeakers to warn riverside residents and urge them to evacuate.This flooding in Nepal comes after the devastating Bhote Koshi River floods in Nepal’s Rasuwa district on August 26. According to the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA), the floods in the Rasuwa and Trishuli river areas claimed 1,455 lives, while 5,285 people remained missing.Authorities in Gorkha are continuing to monitor the Budhi Gandaki’s water levels as rescue teams work in the affected areas and residents are urged to remain alert.
Article Summary: The flood struck the northern part of the Gorkha district around 4 am. Bridges at Arughat, Tripurasundari and Soti-Manbu were among those reported damaged or destroyed. A Bailey bridge connecting wards 1 and 3 of Dharche Rural Municipality was also swept away.

Article Title: ‘Istifa to dena hi hoga’: CJP’s Ashutosh Ranka attacks Gyanesh Kumar after release, says ‘ready to spend life in jail’
Article Text:
Ashutosh Ranka labeled Gyanesh Kumar a traitor

Ashutosh Ranka’s post comes after release from detention

CJP demands Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over SIR





NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party ( CJP ) leader Ashutosh Ranka on Sunday launched a fresh attack on Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar following his release from preventive detention, calling him a “traitor” and declaring that he was willing to spend his life in jail to get people like him removed.In a post on X written in Hindi, Ranka said Gyanesh Kumar must resign and asserted that he would continue fighting against the CEC despite the possibility of prolonged imprisonment.“Gyanesh Kumar is a traitor. He will have to resign.“Even spending my entire life in jail is acceptable to get such traitors removed,” Ranka said.Ranka’s post came hours after an executive magistrate in New Delhi ordered the release of Ranka, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and party leader Saurav Das from detention.The three had been detained by Delhi Police after their flight from Mumbai landed at Indira Gandhi International Airport on Saturday, ahead of the party’s proposed protest at Jantar MantarThe CJP had planned to hold its ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ demonstration to demand Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.The party has also demanded that the revision exercise be scrapped.Delhi Police had denied permission for the proposed demonstration, citing law-and-order concerns, public safety and possible inconvenience to residents.The detention of the three CJP leaders came amid a wider security crackdown, during which more than 7,000 people were detained across the capital.Despite the detentions, the CJP has maintained that it will continue its campaign for free and fair elections.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party ( CJP ) leader Ashutosh Ranka launched a fresh attack on Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Ranka’s post comes after release from detention of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke and party leader Saurav Das.

Article Title: UFC fighter Tim Kennedy shot three times in Africa ambush that left at least 20 dead or wounded: Report
Article Text:
Former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy was shot three times during a deadly Congo ambush that reportedly left at least 20 casualties/ Image: Instagram@timkennedymma

Tim Kennedy shot during deadly ambush in Congo

Kennedy's military background and UFC career

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Joe Rogan Experience

Former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy has been shot three times in the leg during an ambush in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in an attack that reportedly left at least 20 people dead or wounded. The former American soldier was working with a private military and security company when the incident unfolded, and he was evacuated to the United States for treatment after the attack.Kennedy was reportedly working for Vectus Global, a private military and security company led by Erik Prince, when the team came under attack on September 17.According to Reuters, the personnel were carrying out an operation intended to protect mining revenues, combat smuggling and collect taxes for the Congolese government. The team was reportedly travelling between locations when the ambush took place.Sources working with the Congolese government said around 20 people were killed or wounded in the attack, with seven Congolese nationals and Justin Conaglen, a former member of New Zealand's elite Special Air Service, reportedly among those killed. Local villagers may also have been among the casualties.One source suggested that Rwandan forces backing rebel groups might have tracked the team using a surveillance drone before launching the attack, although that account has not been independently established in the supplied reporting.Kennedy was shot three times in the leg but remains in stable condition, according to the reports. After the attack, he was evacuated through Burundi and Johannesburg in South Africa before returning to the United States, where he has been receiving treatment at Walter Reed National Military Medical Center in Washington.Vectus Global also operates in Haiti and other parts of Africa, and has been involved in supporting Congolese government operations, including efforts to help the army secure Uvira in South Kivu from Rwanda-backed rebels.Kennedy served in the US military before establishing himself as a professional mixed martial arts fighter, bringing his military experience into a career that included three years competing in the UFC.He fought in the organisation between July 2013 and December 2016, compiling a record of three wins and two defeats during that period.The American middleweight faced several prominent opponents during his UFC career, including Yoel Romero and Kelvin Gastelum, both of whom defeated him. He later moved away from regular competition, although he has remained involved in conversations about combat sports and military service.Kennedy is also a father of four and has developed a following through his social media accounts, where he discusses politics, culture, fitness and his experiences in the military.He runs a YouTube podcast featuring conversations with former UFC fighters, military veterans and other public figures, and has appeared several times on, discussing his experiences as a military sniper and his time competing in professional fighting.
Article Summary: Tim Kennedy was working with a private military and security company. The team came under attack in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. At least 20 people were killed or wounded in the attack on September 17. Kennedy was shot three times in the leg but remains in stable condition.

Article Title: ‘Gyanesh Kumar at heart of govt’s survival’: CJP’s Saurav Das after Delhi protest detentions
Article Text:
Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das condemned the police's forceful intervention ahead of their scheduled protest

CJP leaders released after detention ahead of Jantar Mantar protest

Over 7,000 detained as Delhi police step up security





NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) spokesperson Saurav Das on Sunday hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah over the police crackdown ahead of the party’s proposed ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ protest, alleging that the security measures exposed the government’s fear of public dissent.Vowing to continue the campaign, Das said the party and its supporters would return “with full strength” and would not be intimidated into silence.In a post on X, Das alleged that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was central to the government’s political survival and accused the authorities of using force and intimidation against citizens exercising their democratic rights.“After Modi-Shah turned Delhi into a fortress and unleashed what can only be described as a war against their own citizens, one thing has become abundantly clear: Gyanesh Kumar is at the very heart of this government’s survival. The unprecedented use of force, intimidation and threats against citizens simply exercising their democratic rights has exposed the government completely.“But we the young generation will continue to demand accountability. We shall neither be intimidated nor silenced. We are not backing down. We are returning with full strength!” Das posted, adding the hashtag #GyanuItsDoneBro.The post comes a day after Delhi Police detained CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, Das and party leader Ashutosh Ranka after their flight from Mumbai landed in the national capital.The three were travelling to Delhi for the proposed protest demanding Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.An executive magistrate on Sunday ordered the release of Dipke, Das and Ranka from detention. Their detention had followed Delhi Police’s decision to deny permission for the demonstration, citing security and law-and-order concerns.The proposed demonstration was prevented from reaching Jantar Mantar amid an extensive security operation across the capital.Delhi Police deployed more than 30,000 police and paramilitary personnel, placed barricades across central Delhi and intensified checks at border points, railway stations and bus terminals.More than 7,000 people were detained across the capital, including opposition leaders and activists, while 45 Metro stations were closed during the security restrictions.The CJP has maintained that its campaign will continue, with demands including Kumar’s resignation and action over alleged voter-list irregularities during the SIR exercise.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) spokesperson Saurav Das hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah over the police crackdown. Das said the security measures exposed the government’s fear of public dissent. He said the party and its supporters would return “with full strength” and would not be intimidated into silence.

Article Title: ‘Abhijeet Dipke? Detained. Vijeta Dahiya? Out!’ Ex-CJP spokesperson mocks party leaders; watch
Article Text:
Vijeta Dahiya publicly mocked Dhruv Rathee, Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das, and Ashutosh Ranka after they were detained.

CJP had removed Dahiya as spokesperson

Over 3,000 detained ahead of CJP protest





NEW DELHI: Former Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) spokesperson Vijeta Dahiya on Saturday mocked party founder Abhijeet Dipke, co-convenor Saurav Das , leader Ashutosh Ranka and YouTuber Dhruv Rathee after they were detained by Delhi Police ahead of a planned protest at Jantar Mantar.In a video posted on Instagram, Dahiya listed the four names, saying each has been detained, before contrasting their fate with his own: “But Vijeta Dahiya? Out!” He followed it with a teasing gesture and bursts out laughing.“Zyada load mat lo (don’t overthink it),” he said, adding that he was heading out just to recite a poem about protest and raise a few slogans. He then told Delhi Police to stop chasing and detaining protesters and arrest criminals instead.“Delhi Police, hosh mein aao (come to your senses),” he said.The video surfaces amid heightened security in Delhi for CJP’s ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ demonstration against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Dahiya was removed as CJP spokesperson in July after videos of him at a burger outlet near a protest site drew criticism while party members and protesters were facing police action during the outfit’s ‘Chalo Sansad’ march.The party described his conduct as “deeply insensitive” and “unacceptable”, saying it was inconsistent with the movement’s values and principles. It also relieved him of all official duties.Dahiya defended his decision to eat at the outlet, saying he was hungry and had been working continuously for the movement.He questioned why eating a burger had become a major issue, arguing that people were overlooking the work done by those involved in the protest.Delhi Police detained more than 3,000 people across the capital as they attempted to reach Jantar Mantar for the proposed CJP demonstration. Detentions were reported near Regal Cinema, Minto Bridge and Akashwani Bhawan, among other locations.Police sources also said more than 600 people with criminal records were detained across Delhi as a preventive measure. Police had denied permission for the protest, citing public safety, traffic management and law-and-order concerns.Dipke, Das and Ranka were detained after arriving in Delhi from Mumbai. Rathee was also detained ahead of the planned demonstration.
Article Summary: Former Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) spokesperson Vijeta Dahiya mocks four detained party members. Dahiya was removed as CJP spokesperson in July after videos of him at a burger outlet near a protest site drew criticism. Police detained more than 3,000 people across the capital as they attempted to reach Jantar Mantar for the proposed demonstration.

Article Title: ‘Cockroaches never die’: CJP reacts after Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das released from detention
Article Text:
the Cockroach Janta Party announced the release of its leaders from detention by Delhi Police





NEW DELHI: The Cockroach Janta Party ( CJP ) on Sunday reacted to the release of its founder Abhijeet Dipke and leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das from detention, saying Delhi Police had been forced to release them.“FINALLY DELHI POLICE IS FORCED TO RELEASE ABHIJEET DIPKE, ASHUTOSH RANKA AND SAURAV DAS. Cockroaches never die,” the party said in a post on X.An executive magistrate in New Delhi ordered the release of the three CJP leaders on Sunday.They had been placed under preventive detention by Delhi Police ahead of the party’s proposed ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.The three leaders were detained from inside an aircraft after their flight from Mumbai landed at Indira Gandhi International Airport on Saturday.The action came after Delhi Police denied permission for the planned demonstration, citing law-and-order concerns, public safety and possible inconvenience to residents.The party had planned to demand the resignation of Kumar and the scrapping of the SIR exercise.The detention had triggered criticism from CJP, which questioned the whereabouts of its leaders and sought their release.The party had also expressed concern over Dipke’s access to his family after his grandmother’s death, with the family preparing for her last rites on Sunday.Earlier, Delhi Police said information about his grandmother’s death had been conveyed to Dipke and that assistance had been offered to facilitate his travel to his hometown for the funeral.The detention of the three leaders came amid a wider police crackdown ahead of the proposed protest, during which more than 7,000 people were detained, including opposition leaders, activists, student leaders and journalists.Police had said due legal process would be followed in the case of the three CJP leaders.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party says Delhi Police forced to release its leaders. Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das were placed under preventive detention by Delhi Police. The three leaders were detained from inside an aircraft after their flight from Mumbai landed at Indira Gandhi International Airport.

Article Title: CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das kept under preventive arrest, says Delhi police
Article Text:
CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das were placed under preventive arrest by Delhi Police

CJP leaders detained at Delhi airport





NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and party leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das have been placed under preventive arrest and will be produced before an executive magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station on Saturday, Delhi Police said.The development comes amid heightened security in the national capital ahead of the party’s proposed ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Delhi Police had denied permission for the proposed demonstration, citing law-and-order concerns, public safety and possible inconvenience to residents. The party had planned to demand Kumar’s resignation and the scrapping of the SIR exercise.CJP’s legal head Ratna Singh, in a post on X, said the three leaders would be produced before the executive magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station at 9am.“Abhijeet, Ashutosh and Saurav will be produced before the Executive Magistrate at Delhi Cantt Police Station at 9 AM today,” Singh wrote, adding that a Delhi Police official had informed her about the development that morning.She said she would be present at the police station along with other advocates representing the party.Dipke, Ranka and Das were detained by Delhi Police after their Delhi-bound flight from Mumbai landed at Indira Gandhi International Airport on Saturday.The action came before the planned protest, with police personnel entering the aircraft to take the leaders into custody.In a video from the flight, Dipke was seen questioning the police action and challenging officers to arrest him. He also questioned the grounds for the detention, while slogans including “Bharat Mata ki Jai” and “Inquilab Zindabad” were raised.The CJP leaders had earlier said they were prepared to face arrest but would continue their campaign over the electoral roll revision exercise.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das were placed under preventive arrest by Delhi Police. The development comes amid heightened security in the national capital ahead of the party’s proposed ‘Jantar Mantar 2.0’ protest.

Article Title: Hyderabad horror: Man stabs married woman to death for rejecting proposal
Article Text:
Tahera Banu was fatally attacked at her workplace by a former co-worker named Ibrahim (Representative image)





HYDERABAD: A 40-year-old woman was stabbed to death at her workplace by a former co-worker in Chaderghat on Friday night. The accused was apprehended by the police on Saturday, and he is being interrogated.Tahera Banu, a resident of Chanchalguda, had been working at Manha luxurious women’s store in Azampura, Chaderghat, for the past six months.According to police, the attack took place around 9.30 pm at the store. “The assailant had an argument with Tahera. During the argument, he pulled out a knife from his pocket and stabbed her multiple times,” Charminar DCP Kiran Prabhakar Khare said.According to Chaderghat inspector K Brahma Murari, at the time of the assault, there were two other workers, including a woman, in the shop. After the attack, the accused, Ibrahim , fled from the spot and the co-workers immediately shifted her to a hospital in Chaderghat. She was later referred to Osmania General Hospital in a 108 ambulance. “Doctors at OGH found she had suffered serious injuries to her throat and nose. She was declared dead at around 10.30 pm,” Tahera’s husband Mohammed Khaja Moinuddin said.Ibrahim, a resident of Santosh Nagar, used to work in the same shop till a year ago. “Prima facie, we know that the accused was earlier involved in a domestic harassment-cum-dowry case,” the DCP said.In his complaint, Moinuddin, who runs a meat shop at Karmanghat, said he had been married to Tahera for 24 years and that the couple had two daughters and a son. He said he learnt about the attack from their daughter Asra Banu, after returning home around 9.45 pm.“I made enquiries with the other workers after the incident and learnt that Ibrahim, who previously worked at the same shop, had proposed to marry my wife. As she refused and ignored him, Ibrahim developed a grudge and attacked her with a knife inside the store,” Moinuddin alleged in his complaint.Based on the complaint, Chaderghat police registered a case under Section 103(1) (murder) against Ibrahim on Friday night. Ibrahim was apprehended from Santosh Nagar on Saturday. He is being interrogated by the police.
Article Summary: Tahera Banu, a resident of Chanchalguda, had been working at Manha luxurious women’s store in Azampura, Chaderghat, for the past six months. The accused was apprehended by the police on Saturday, and he is being interrogated. “Prima facie, we know that the accused was earlier involved in a domestic harassment- cum-dowry case,” the DCP said.

Article Title: ‘Blackmailed for months’: How bizman’s deadly 'fall' from 4th floor landed model Shraddha Dubey in soup
Article Text:
Restaurant entrepreneur Shiva Sharma (27) died after allegedly falling from a fourth-floor flat.

Mother alleges son was assaulted before death

Family alleges blackmail and threats

Sister claims to have evidence of harassment

Police probe circumstances of death





LUCKNOW: A 27-year-old restaurant owner died after allegedly falling from the fourth floor of an apartment near Balu Adda in Lucknow on Saturday.His mother has accused his girlfriend, social media influencer Shraddha Dubey, and her associates of murdering him.The deceased, Shiva Sharma , owned a chain of restaurants and also operated a cafe. His family alleged that he had been subjected to physical assault, intimidation and blackmail for several months.Hazratganj police have registered an FIR against Dubey, her sister Rashmi Dubey, her driver, an associate named Adil and several unidentified people. Police said they were investigating the circumstances that led to Sharma's fall.In a complaint submitted to Hazratganj police on October 10, Sharma's mother, Ranjana Sharma, alleged that she received a call from Adil, an associate of Dubey, at around 7 pm on October 9.He reportedly told her that Shiva's condition had deteriorated and that he was being taken to King George's Medical University.Ranjana said she reached the medical college with other family members, where the people accompanying her son showed them his body from a distance before fleeing.Doctors subsequently declared him dead.She alleged that her son had multiple injuries and was wearing only underwear when the family saw his body. Ranjana expressed suspicion that Dubey, her driver, her sister, Adil and other associates had assaulted and killed him.These allegations have not been independently established.In her complaint, Ranjana alleged that Dubey had been harassing her son for the past four months, threatening to implicate him in false cases and damage his reputation.She claimed that Dubey pressured Shiva to remain in a relationship with her and resorted to blackmail and physical violence when he resisted.The family further alleged that Shiva had previously been assaulted and pressured into maintaining a relationship against his wishes.Ranjana also claimed that Dubey had visited her shop about a week before the incident and threatened her over her son.Shiva's elder sister, Astha, told TOI that Dubey had been harassing her brother for several days. She said she had seen their WhatsApp chats and had evidence to support her claim.“They met at a party through a common friend four months ago,” she added.ACP Hazratganj Rajneesh Verma said the circumstances leading to Shiva's fall were being investigated.He said police had registered a case against Dubey, her sister Rashmi Dubey, her driver, Adil and unidentified others, and that further action would be taken based on the family's complaint.
Article Summary: Shiva Sharma, 27, died after allegedly falling from a fourth-floor flat in Lucknow. His mother has accused his girlfriend, social media influencer Shraddha Dubey, and her associates of murdering him. His family alleged that he had been subjected to physical assault, intimidation and blackmail for several months.

Article Title: AI, drones reshaping warfare, says Rajnath at Tarang Shakti finale
Article Text: Jodhpur: Defence minister Rajnath Singh Saturday said future military strength would depend on a country’s ability to detect threats, assess situations and respond swiftly, as artificial intelligence (AI), drones and electronic warfare transform modern combat.Addressing the closing ceremony of the multinational air exercise Tarang Shakti-2026 at Jodhpur Air Force Station, Singh stressed the need to strengthen indigenous defence manufacturing and advanced military technologies to meet emerging security challenges.He said no country could sustain a prolonged conflict under uncertain circumstances without the capacity to manufacture its own weapons and develop critical technologies.Singh said India’s armed forces were undergoing structural, technological and strategic transformation. Unmanned systems and drones had changed the pace and scale of military operations, while AI was reshaping battlefield decision-making.Information, precision, speed and coordination between military systems would determine outcomes in future conflicts, he said, adding that electronic warfare required effective control over the electromagnetic spectrum.“Modern warfare was no longer confined to land, sea and air, with space, cyberspace, the electromagnetic spectrum and the information domain emerging as increasingly important operational areas,” he said.Highlighting indigenous capabilities, Singh cited the Tejas fighter aircraft and Akash missile defence system as examples of India’s technological progress. He expressed confidence that the country would make significant progress in developing fifth-generation fighter aircraft.The minister also called for deeper defence partnerships with friendly nations through joint research, development, training and co-production, rather than limiting cooperation to purchasing aircraft and weapons.Singh said the exercise, attended by observers from 32 countries, would strengthen mutual trust and facilitate the exchange of operational experience.
Article Summary: Singh said India’s armed forces were undergoing structural, technological and strategic transformation. Unmanned systems and drones had changed the pace and scale of military operations. Information, precision, speed and coordination between military systems would determine outcomes in future conflicts, he said.

Article Title: Shraddha Walkar murder case: Delhi court allows online testimony of WhatsApp, Google, Bumble officials
Article Text:
A Delhi court has allowed Delhi Police to record video testimony from foreign tech officials in Shraddha Walkar murder case

Court allows online testimony of foreign tech officials

WhatsApp, Google, Gmail and Bumble officials named as witnesses

Delhi court sets up video-conferencing arrangements for foreign witnesses

Witness examination to begin on December 1

Court lays down rules for serving summons to foreign witnesses





NEW DELHI: A Delhi court has allowed Delhi Police to record the testimony of nodal officers of WhatsApp, Google, Gmail and Bumble through video conferencing from abroad in the Shraddha Walkar murder case, in which Aaftab Amin Poonawala is facing trial.The court said securing the physical presence of the witnesses would involve considerable expense and delay, and directed that their depositions be recorded from December 1, 2026, with one witness examined each day.Additional Sessions Judge (ASJ) Hargurvarinder Singh Jaggi allowed the prosecution's application on Saturday, noting that the witnesses are based in the United States and the United Kingdom. The trial is nearing its conclusion."Having considered the application and given that these witnesses reside abroad, securing their physical attendance before this Court would entail undue delay and exorbitant expense. In the interest of an expeditious trial and justice, the application moved by the prosecution is allowed," ASJ Jaggi ordered on Saturday.The court directed that a copy of the order be forwarded to the Consulate General of India, the High Commission of India, the Joint Secretary, CPV (Consular, Passport and Visa) Division of the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), and the nodal authority of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) for information and necessary compliance.The prosecution sought to examine foreign nodal officers who are required to tender evidence through affidavits under Section 296 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (CrPC), and the corresponding provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.The witnesses identified by Delhi Police are:- Adrian Silvera, nodal officer for WhatsApp LLC and Meta Platforms Inc., residing at 1 Hacker Way, Menlo Park, California, USA.- Shelby Smith, nodal officer for Google LLC, based in Austin, Texas, USA.- Arti Sheth, nodal officer for Google (Gmail), whose office is at 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, California 94043, USA.- Luke Mitsi, nodal officer and law enforcement operations manager for Bumble Group, whose office is at 2 Sheraton Street, London, United Kingdom.The court directed that the Court Point for recording the depositions would be the video-conferencing courtroom of the South District at Saket Courts Complex in Delhi.The Remote Point for each summoned witness will be the nearest Indian embassy or high commission corresponding to the witness's residential or official address.An official designated by the respective Indian embassy, high commission or consulate general will act as the Remote Point Coordinator.Inspector Ram Singh, the investigating officer in the case, has been authorised to act as a liaison officer to ensure that all necessary permissions and authorisations are processed through the appropriate channels in a time-bound manner.The court specified that the witnesses' testimony would be recorded at the rate of one witness per day, beginning December 1, 2026.The Court Point Coordinator has been directed to prepare a detailed date sheet in coordination with the Remote Point Coordinators, Special Public Prosecutor (SPP) and defence counsel.SPP Madhukar Pandey is appearing for Delhi Police.The court directed that all processes and summons be served on the witnesses through the MHA and MEA in accordance with the law and the prevailing Comprehensive Guidelines for Investigation Abroad and issuance of Letters Rogatory (LRs) or Mutual Legal Assistance (MLA) Requests and Service of Summons, as mandated under Rule 9(5) and Rule 12.It also clarified that the summons must explicitly specify the venue of the Remote Point, the date and time of the deposition, and the requirement for identity proof. All parties have been directed to account for differences in time zones while scheduling the proceedings.Advocate Akshay Bhandari, along with Megha Saroa, is representing Poonawala, while advocate Seema Kushwaha is appearing for the complainant.(With ANI inputs)
Article Summary: A Delhi court has allowed Delhi Police to record video testimony from foreign tech officials in Shraddha Walkar murder case. The witnesses are based in the United States and the United Kingdom. The court said securing the physical presence of the witnesses would involve considerable expense and delay.

Article Title: M K Stalin slams centre, TVK govt over detention of SIR protesters
Article Text:
M K Stalin and Vijay





CHENNAI: DMK president and former chief minister M K Stalin on Saturday criticised the BJP-led govt at the Centre for detaining former chief ministers Pinarayi Vijayan, Arvind Kejriwal and Mamata Banerjee, senior political leaders from various parties and student organisation leaders protesting against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. He contrasted their detention with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar continuing to enjoy Z+ security, despite what he called acts of “treason”.“What a disgrace!” Stalin said in a post on X, condemning the detention of political leaders and student organisation members in New Delhi.“The conspiracy behind SIR has been completely exposed. There is no hiding it anymore! Barricading #Delhi, shutting down the internet and detaining political leaders cannot crush the uprising of India's youth,” he said, questioning how long the Union govt could keep the entire nation under siege.Turning his criticism towards Tamil Nadu, Stalin accused the “Kakistocratic TVK govt” of trying to please its “Delhi masters” by detaining activists protesting against SIR and demanding Kumar's resignation. He called for the immediate release of all those detained.“Gyanesh Kumar must be sacked, SIR must be halted, and everyone responsible for betraying the people of India must be held accountable,” Stalin said.He also tagged the official X handles of CJP, SFI and AISA, along with those of their functionaries, to show his support for the protests.
Article Summary: DMK president and former chief minister M K Stalin criticised the BJP-led govt at the Centre for detaining political leaders. He contrasted their detention with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar continuing to enjoy Z+ security, despite what he called acts of ‘treason’

Article Title: CJP protest: What’s open and what’s closed in Delhi on October 10
Article Text:
CJP protest scheduled for October 10

What will be closed

1. All retail liquor stores

2. Several Mail and Express trains

3. Entry and exit gates at 57 Metro stations may be closed

What will remain open

1. Licensed restaurants, bars and clubs

2. Other regular services

Police step up security ahead of protests





NEW DELHI: Delhi will see restrictions on retail liquor sales and cancellations of several Mail and Express trains on October 10 amid planned protests by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), Left groups and student outfits of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.The protests are also aimed at seeking the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police have stepped up security and outreach efforts across the city, urging residents, students and young people to avoid activities that could disrupt public order.Here is a look at what will remain open and what will be closed in Delhi on October 10.All retail liquor outlets across Delhi will remain closed on October 9 and 10 following an order issued by the excise department on October 8.The closure applies to retail liquor vends operating under specified licence categories, including outlets selling Indian liquor, foreign liquor and country liquor, as well as certain outlets in malls.The excise department said the decision was taken as a preventive measure to maintain public order in view of the prevailing situation and inputs received from Delhi Police.However, liquor sales at licensed restaurants, bars and clubs will continue as usual, an official clarified.Indian Railways has ordered the cancellation of several Mail and Express trains scheduled to arrive at New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin railway stations between 4am and 2pm on October 10.According to a railway order issued on October 9, trains departing from their originating stations after 2pm on October 9 and scheduled to reach either of the two stations during the specified period on October 10 will be cancelled at source.The decision was taken due to the possibility of severe road traffic congestion around the two railway stations. Railway officials have not confirmed whether the cancellations are directly linked to the planned protests.Delhi Police have asked DMRC to close entry and exit gates at 57 Metro stations from 9pm on October 9 and continue the restrictions on October 10 until the situation normalises. Train frequency at these stations may also be reduced in view of the proposed protests at Jantar Mantar and other locations. Passengers are advised to check DMRC updates before travelling.While retail liquor shops will remain shut, licensed restaurants, bars and clubs in Delhi will continue to serve liquor as usual, according to an excise department official.No blanket closure of other regular public services or commercial establishments has been announced in the information available. Residents should check for specific advisories before travelling or making plans.Delhi Police have warned against the proposed CJP protest on October 10, stating that Section 163 is in force in the national capital and any gathering in violation of the restrictions would be considered illegal.Police teams have contacted market welfare associations, resident welfare associations and Aman committees in several areas, asking them to counsel people against participating in activities that could disturb public order.Sources said police were also checking hotels for last-minute bookings and monitoring railway stations and other transit points. Officers were approaching groups gathered at these locations to inquire about their plans.The protests have been called over alleged irregularities in the SIR exercise, with demonstrators also demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
Article Summary: All retail liquor outlets across Delhi will remain closed on October 9 and 10. Several Mail and Express trains scheduled to arrive at New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin railway stations will be cancelled. Entry and exit gates at 57 Metro stations may be closed. Police have stepped up security and outreach efforts.

Article Title: 'Youth are no longer scared of you, PM Modi': CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke
Article Text:
“I’ll be landing in Delhi tomorrow and will march to Jantar Mantar, come what may,” Dipke tweeted.

Delhi Police

warns against CJP protest on October 10

Dipke shares Bengaluru visit, thanks

Prakash Raj

(With agency inputs)





NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) leader Abhijeet Dipke on Friday said he would march to Delhi’s Jantar Mantar on October 10, despite police restrictions on the proposed protest.In a post on X, Dipke alleged that thousands of youngsters had been detained across the country ahead of the demonstration and accused the BJP government of trying to intimidate protesters.“Thousands of youngsters have been detained across country by the BJP Govt ahead of our October 10 protest.“This intimidation is not going to work, Modi. The youth of this country are no longer scared of you.“I’ll be landing in Delhi tomorrow and will march to Jantar Mantar, come what may,” Dipke tweeted.The statement came amid Delhi Police’s warning against the proposed CJP protest, with the force saying that prohibitory restrictions under Section 163 were in force in the national capital and that unauthorised gatherings would invite legal action.Deputy commissioner of police (DCP) Shrishti Pandey said protests were not permitted at Jantar Mantar or any other location while the restrictions remained in force.“Section 163 is in effect, meaning protests are not permitted—neither at Jantar Mantar nor anywhere else. Any gathering will be considered illegal, and we would be compelled to take necessary legal action against it,” Pandey told news agency ANI.The DCP also urged people not to take part in the proposed demonstration, asking them to prioritise their safety and that of their families.“I would like to urge the protestors not to participate in such illegal gatherings. Please prioritise your own safety as well. Also, consider the safety of your family,” she said.Earlier on Friday, Dipke shared a separate post about his recent visit to Bengaluru, thanking those who had welcomed him during his stay.“Leaving Bengaluru with so much love in my heart. The warmth, affection and kindness I’ve received over the last two days have been truly overwhelming,” he wrote.Dipke also thanked Kavitha Lankesh and Esha Lankesh, referring to them as his “new family”, and said he hoped to return to the city.He expressed gratitude to actor Prakash Raj and his “elder sister” Aafreen Nawaz for inviting him to Bengaluru and introducing him to the city’s warmth and generosity.“You’ve all given me more than just beautiful memories. You’ve given me a home to return to,” he added.
Article Summary: “I’ll be landing in Delhi tomorrow and will march to Jantar Mantar, come what may,” Dipke tweeted. The statement came amid Delhi Police’s warning against the proposed CJP protest. The force said that prohibitory restrictions under Section 163 were in force.
